scope: Browser interaction reference; these are 40 concrete paths, not all product gaps and not native implementation completion.
native: Unchanged: no native operating-system adapters delivered in this pass.
visualQA: Browser visuals, actual audio playback and target-device performance remain unverified. DOM checks do not render layout.
remaining: Free-position 8px-grid drag/resize and user-installed widget discovery.
Workspace window switching, real tmux drawer, filesystem view and command execution.
Remaining PRD coverage stays in the separate 107-requirement audit.

paths.title: Radio lifecycle
paths.before: The radio was only a boolean.
paths.after: Turning Bluetooth off disconnects its devices and returns audio to speakers.

paths.title: Discovery and cancellation
paths.before: No device list or scanning lifecycle.
paths.after: Discover sample devices, cancel an in-progress scan, and prevent late results.

paths.title: Pairing confirmation
paths.after: Inspect a keyboard comparison code, confirm pairing or cancel without pairing.

paths.title: Unreachable device and retry
paths.after: The out-of-range speaker fails with recovery guidance and Retry/Cancel.

paths.title: Forget a paired device
paths.after: Two-click forget clears pairing, disconnects and updates available audio outputs.

paths.title: Output routing
paths.after: Connected audio devices enter the output selector; disconnecting removes them and falls back.

paths.title: Mute and restore
paths.after: Mute silences the effective level while preserving the previous volume for unmute.

paths.title: Application mixer
paths.after: Media and browser gains combine with the master level in the shared model.

paths.title: Microphone controls
paths.after: Choose a sample input, adjust gain and mute it, with explicit no-capture status.

paths.title: Explicit test sound
paths.before: No way to verify the interaction.
paths.after: Test sound generates a short browser tone; muted/unsupported paths explain recovery. Browser audio output remains controlled by the browser.
paths.verification: Browser audio QA pending; code path checked

paths.title: Bounded brightness
paths.before: Slider values were disconnected from details.
paths.after: The quick slider and detail slider share state and visibly change preview brightness.

paths.title: Night-light intensity
paths.after: Warmth controls a visible overlay; disabling it removes the effect.

paths.title: Power consequences
paths.before: Power saver was only a boolean.
paths.after: Power policy changes material effects, graph availability and 1/2/5-second sampling; the Effects selector updates the same policy.

paths.title: Unavailable hardware
paths.before: Missing hardware looked like a working setting.
paths.after: External brightness and battery capabilities are explicitly unavailable on the sample device.

paths.title: Reset with recovery
paths.after: Reset all display preferences and undo to the exact prior brightness, warmth and power mode.

paths.title: Grouped history and unread state
paths.before: Two fixed entries with only dismiss.
paths.after: Group by source, filter unread, and synchronize the top-bar unread badge.

paths.title: Actionable navigation
paths.after: Open the associated Dev details and mark the message read.

paths.title: Snooze and return
paths.after: Snooze for one minute, restore immediately with Undo, or let it reappear on the next active refresh.

paths.title: Delivery rules
paths.before: Do not disturb changed a label.
paths.after: Timed DND and per-app muting suppress new toast alerts while keeping history; sample events expose the effect.

paths.title: Clear and undo isolation
paths.after: Restore dismissed entries without deleting notifications that arrived after clearing.

paths.title: History, range and freeze
paths.before: Static CPU values and a fixed sparkline.
paths.after: Collect bounded timestamped samples, select 15/30/60-second history, freeze and resume.

paths.title: Process inspection
paths.after: Filter and sort process rows by name, CPU or memory; show an empty search state.

paths.title: Volume inspection
paths.after: Choose a volume and inspect its mount, used/free space and I/O.

paths.title: Provider failure recovery
paths.after: A sensor failure preserves a labeled stale sample and supports cancellable retry; other system samples continue.

paths.title: Visibility and Lite behavior
paths.after: System sampling runs only in the visible inspector, stops when closed/hidden/frozen, follows the effect interval and replaces graphs in Lite.

paths.title: Container start and stop
paths.after: Actions update state, CPU/memory, listening port, logs, widget summary and notifications together.

paths.title: Restart and log continuity
paths.before: Logs were a label in a generic detail list.
paths.after: Restart appends a timestamped lifecycle event; filtered logs remain through inspector close/reopen.

paths.title: Arming and pending cancellation
paths.before: Actions had no protection or busy state.
paths.after: Start/stop/restart require a second click within two seconds; pending work can be cancelled or is cancelled on close.

paths.title: Service authorization failure
paths.after: Toggle sample services; the denied Docker-engine scenario leaves its state unchanged and exposes Retry.

paths.title: Kubernetes scope
paths.after: Move between missing-context state and the sample cluster, then filter readiness by namespace.

paths.title: Gallery membership
paths.after: See installed sample widgets, add/remove them and immediately update desktop membership.

paths.title: S/M/L presentation
paths.after: Select compact, normal or wide presentation; compact hides secondary details and wide expands available space.

paths.title: Accessible ordering
paths.after: Move widgets with keyboard-operable buttons; visual and DOM order change together in the responsive grid. Free-position dragging is still pending.

paths.title: Independent profiles
paths.after: Minimal/work/pentest/music keep independent membership, order and size and survive reload.

paths.title: Layout recovery
paths.after: Undo removal/addition or reset of a profile without affecting the other profiles.

paths.title: Queue navigation
paths.after: Select queue entries or use Previous/Next; the desktop and control center show the same title.

paths.title: Seek and track boundaries
paths.before: Play toggled a glyph, time stayed static.
paths.after: Seek, play/pause, advance at track end and stop or repeat at queue end. This is transport simulation without music streaming.

paths.title: Missing player recovery
paths.after: Disconnect the demo player, disable transport, show the empty state, then restore it.

paths.title: Durable notes and typing
paths.before: A basic textarea with no save lifecycle.
paths.after: Debounced autosave keeps the editor DOM/caret, preserves text on reload and reports storage failure as session-only.

paths.title: Note copy, denial and undo
paths.after: Copy a note or explain clipboard denial; clear it and restore with Undo.
